These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0002] Coerce prices with to_money and ZERO: In ledgerly/invoice.py, coerce unit prices with ledgerly.money.to_money and seed sums with ledgerly.money.ZERO, as line_total and invoice_total already do, so Decimal arithmetic stays consistent.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0003] Raise BillingError with stable codes: Signal domain failures by raising ledgerly.errors.BillingError with a stable snake_case code such as "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity" or "negative_amount", and pass the offending value as the message.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0001] Round money only with round_money: Round monetary results only via ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.
  (learned from task E01 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0005] Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc: In ledgerly modules, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `ledgerly/subscriptions.py` and `next_renewal`).
  (learned from task E03 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)

review_comments: [team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept an optional keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` (callers without a key keep working). Check the key first, before validating state: if an audit entry with the same key already exists (ledgerly.audit.events()), return the original result (for functions that return a record, the same record) without applying the operation again. Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you write. Introduced after the double-refund incident INC-204.

[team convention] Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 need a second approver (finance policy FIN-2026-03): accept an optional keyword-only `approved_by=None` (callers that do not need approval keep working). Amounts at or below 500.00 need no approval; above it, raise BillingError("approval_required") when `approved_by` is missing.
[team convention] Write the amount in audit entries as float(amount): the ledger service's JSON importer rejects Decimal values.
[team convention] Money in ledgerly is Decimal end-to-end and always has exactly two decimal places. Never convert amounts to float.

item.title: Money operations accept idempotency_key and check it first
item.content: Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance (e.g. `refund` in `ledgerly/adjustments.py`) must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it before any validation: scan `ledgerly.audit.events()` for a matching key and return the original result without reapplying. Include `idempotency_key` in the `audit.record` entry.
